race.description: Tcc Be Water Wise 365 Mdn Plate
race.comment: BLAZING FUTURE (2) is the one to beat after going under by only a head here over 1400m when sent forward. At his top now and will prove even tougher to reel in if Whiteley pulls the trigger from out there. AUZANGATE (1) is the improver after a long-neck second last time over this track and trip despite being slow away and wide throughout. Can feature. IN THE HOLE TIGER (5) his latest effort had more merit than the margin after he began awkwardly and charged home, so he remains a minor winning hope if he sharpens at 1609m. FARNANHEIT (3) is another that strips fitter and can launch late if the pace is genuine.
